# equinix_fabric_ip_block (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows users to fetch an Equinix Fabric IP Block by UUID.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/IP-Blocks



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_block_id` (String) The UUID of the IP block this data source should retrieve

### Read-Only

- `account` (Attributes) Account associated with the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account))
- `assets` (Attributes List) List of assets (connections or services) using this IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Audit log of changes to the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the IP block resource
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource
- `location` (Attributes) Location of the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `order` (Attributes) Order details for the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--order))
- `ownership` (String) Ownership of the IP block. One of: EQUINIX, CUSTOMER
- `prefix` (String) The assigned IP prefix (e.g. 192.0.2.0/24)
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the IP block (e.g. 24 for a /24 block)
- `project` (Attributes) Project associated with the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the IP block
- `type` (String) Type of the IP block product
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the IP block
